canada.title: Alberta landowners should be allowed to kill problem grizzly bears, says rural municipalities group
canada.summary: The Rural Municipalities of Alberta will lobby the province on grizzly bear management changes for the third time since 2024. Yellowhead County and other municipalities are calling for landowners to be allowed to kill grizzlies that pose a threat to their livestock or property.

lines: Good morning. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.

Finland’s military said on Thursday its forces had detected “a strike” on a Russian warship in the Baltic Sea a day earlier, but that the security situation in the area remained stable, The Canadian Press reports.

The 90-minute meeting took place Thursday, days after Stellantis confirmed it was selling the idled Brampton Assembly Plant to Canadian armoured vehicle manufacturer Roshel, ending plans to retool the facility for production of the next-generation Jeep Compass, The Canadian Press reports.

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Friday he was frustrated with the Commerce Department’s delay in implementing controls over the export of certain Nvidia chips to China, The Canadian Press reports.

Microsoft said progress is being made in bringing its popular workplace software back online as a global outage enters its second day, disrupting business communications, police emergency calls, court operations and AI tools, The Canadian Press reports.
Police in Cape Breton disrupt major, national stolen vehicle trafficking ring, The Canadian Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.

bds.h: Bessent blames Lutnick's Commerce Department for not restricting Nvidia chips to China
bds.lede: WASHINGTON (AP) — Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Friday he was frustrated with the Commerce Department’s delay in implementing controls over the export of certain Nvidia chips to China.
rows: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick faces new scrutiny over the Commerce Department's oversight of Nvidia's chip exports after Jensen Huang resigned as CEO. CBS News' Olivia Gazis reports, and Gerrit De Vynck, tech reporter for "The Washington Post," joins to discuss.
WASHINGTON (AP) — Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Friday he was frustrated with the Commerce Department’s delay in implementing controls over the export of certain Nvidia chips to China.

Nvidia has lost about $1.8tn (€1.6tn) in market value since its record close on 6 October. After Jensen Huang’s exit, investors are weighing whether the chipmaker can keep growing at the pace that made it the biggest name in AI.

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s stunning resignation has sent ripples through the global technology industry, with rival chipmakers itching to take advantage of the uncertainty and others wondering if the downfall of one of AI’s biggest cheerleaders will dampen the mood around the civilization-altering…
